skills.description:
项目需求解析Skill - 用于自动化解析项目需求文档，提取结构化信息并生成Excel汇总表。

触发场景：
1. 用户提到"解析项目需求"、"项目需求书"、"需求文档"
2. 用户要求从文件夹读取项目文档并生成Excel
3. 用户需要提取项目信息（项目名称、编码、金额、人员需求、技能标签等）
4. 用户要求按6大技能分类（云网/数据/安全/平台/AI/视频）自动映射
5. 用户需要项目需求池汇总、人员需求清单、数据校验说明等输出
6. 用户说"继续解析"、"增量解析"（复用上次文件夹路径）

路径配置：
- 输入/输出路径均可由用户自由指定
- 支持增量解析（追加到现有Excel）
- 首次使用询问文件夹路径，后续自动记忆

支持输入格式：.docx 项目需求文档
支持输出格式：Excel (.xlsx) 含多Sheet（项目需求池汇总、数据校验说明）
skills.description_zh:
|## 核心定位

双层身份定位：
1. **项目需求解析专家** - 精准提取项目文档中的结构化信息
2. **PMO项目管理专员** - 标准化输出，支持项目池管理和资源统筹

## 6大技能标签体系（固定分类）

所有项目必须映射到以下6大类技能标签：

| 技能类别 | 典型技能项 | 关键词识别 |
|---------|-----------|-----------|
| **云网** | 云资源交付、网络调试、SDN、边缘计算 | 服务器、存储、网络、云、交换机、网关、IoT、物联网、边缘 |
| **数据** | 数据采集、ETL、数据仓库、数据中台、数据治理、SQL开发 | 数据、ETL、数据治理、数据中台、数据仓库、数据库、SQL |
| **安全** | 等保、安全运维、防火墙、渗透测试、安全合规 | 安全、等保、防护、加密、漏洞、WAF、合规 |
| **平台** | PaaS平台、DevOps、中间件、运维平台、统一门户 | 平台、系统、PaaS、DevOps、中间件、容器 |
| **AI** | 机器学习、智能应用、大模型、算法 | AI、人工智能、算法、机器学习、深度学习、智能、大模型 |
| **视频** | 视频监控、视频会议、视频云、可视化大屏 | 视频、监控、SCADA、可视化、大屏 |
skills.name: 项目技术需求解析Skill

skills.description: Lyn Alden's Broken Money — an executable toolkit that explains how the global monetary system works, why fiat money loses value over time, and what alternatives exist for preserving purchasing power and building financial resilience.  Covers 5 use cases: ① Monetary System Basics — understand how money works, from gold to fiat to crypto ("How does money actually work" "Why does inflation happen") ② Inflation Protection — preserve purchasing power in a depreciating currency ("My savings are losing value" "How to protect myself from inflation") ③ Banking & Financial System — understand how banks create money and the risks they pose ("How do banks work" "Why do bank runs happen") ④ Investment Framework — make informed decisions about assets across the monetary cycle ("Where should I put my money now" "How to invest during inflation") ⑤ Bitcoin & Alternatives — understand the case for sound money and digital assets ("Is Bitcoin real money" "What is the future of money")  Trigger when users say: "Broken Money" "Lyn Alden" "Inflation protection" "How money works" "Fiat money" "Banking system" "Bitcoin" "Monetary policy" "Why is inflation so high" "How to preserve wealth" "Financial system" or mention: Lyn Alden / Broken Money / monetary system / inflation / fiat currency / banking / central banking / gold / Bitcoin / sound money / purchasing power / Federal Reserve / money creation / financial history.  Related skills: rich-dad-poor-dad (money mindset), the-millionaire-fastlane (wealth building), financial-feminist (personal finance), the-richest-man-in-babylon (saving principles).
